newsitem.title: UK: Madonna goes house-hunting in London.
newsitem.headline: Madonna goes house-hunting in London.

text.p: Madonna has gone house-hunting in London and has fallen for a palatial mansion where the future King Edward VII is said to have conducted his affair with actress Lillie Langtry.
"I think she fell in love with it," George Apter said after recovering from the shock of opening the door of his 4.5 million pound ($7.35 million) house to one of the world's most famous rock stars.
Apter, who hires antique props to film and TV companies, told The Sun newspaper: "She was worried about security but our house has a high wall and railings so it is ideal."
Madonna wants her six-month-old daughter Lourdes to go to school in Britain. "At least people read books here," she said on her last visit to London.
The star of Evita is believed to have viewed up to six houses in London. Apter's mansion boasts nine bedrooms and an indoor swimming pool.
